evals.prompt: Build a new interactive 'Save for Later' button on the story card in the briefing reader.
expectations: Checks status and scope before modifying code
Generates a 1-page Feature Brief using assets/feature-brief-template.md
Audits all 7 states (idle, loading, active, empty, error, disabled, offline) with explicit N/A justification
Selects canonical control archetypes from controls guide and inlined decision matrix without inventing bespoke classes
Enforces phone-first sheet pattern (<40rem) and 8pt grid compliance
Verifies first-load JS bundle ceiling (130 KB budget) and runs multi-layer verification

evals.prompt: Check feature branch readiness and run preflight verification for the completed playback speed popover.
expectations: Executes python .claude/skills/feature/scripts/verify_feature.py --status as a lightweight early check
Checks the changed files for em dashes and runs npm run design-check, which holds the colour-token rules
Relies on the gate's postbuild checkBundle for the 130 KB first-load budget instead of a separate bundle command
Halts early if no pending edits or flags failure before full suite run
